content:
**Mystery Meat** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Generates 1 random raw meat when any type of Stimpak is consumed, once per 60 seconds.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Stimpaks generate excessive, edible meat. Higher Rads improve the chance. | 003472CD | 
| ★★ | 2 | Stimpaks generate more edible meat tissue. Higher Rads improve the chance. | 003472CC | 
| ★ | 1 | Stimpaks may generate edible meat tissue. Higher Rads improve the chance. | 003472CB |
